name: Survivor leg
description: One stubby leg of a survivor, hinged at the origin: hip at [0,0], limb hanging down +y, so a `rot` track swings it from the hip. A short soft-cornered leg in dark hose and a round little shoe pointing forward (+x) — a child's leg, drawn the way a plush toy has legs, because the survivors are built at two heads tall and everything below the head is small. `far` is the leg on the other side, a step darker.

far.description: The far leg: darker hose, darker shoe, so it reads as behind.
